caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular swatch of tartan or plaid fabric set against an off-white or light beige background. The fabric consists of a weave of intersecting horizontal and vertical bands in various colors, primarily including blue, red, and yellow, with accents of white and dark green. The pattern forms a grid of squares and rectangles, with the colors overlapping to create additional blended shades at the intersections. The edges of the fabric have a slightly frayed or fuzzy appearance, outlined by the small, short strokes of color projecting out from the perimeter. The rectangular swatch is centered within a lightly outlined larger square, and in the bottom right of the larger square, there is handwritten text that reads “Frank Mace / 1937”. There are no other objects or decorative elements within the image.
title: Plaid Homespun Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
